SELECT t.id, t.main_title AS mainTitle, t.summary, t.topic_status AS topicStatus, t.confidence_score AS confidenceScore, t.platform_count AS platformCount, t.hotspot_count AS hotspotCount, t.related_platforms AS relatedPlatforms, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.last_seen_time, t.first_seen_time, t.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS topicDate, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(h.hot_value, 0)), 0) AS totalHotValue, t.first_seen_time AS firstSeenTime, t.last_seen_time AS lastSeenTime, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cross_platform_topic t LEFT JOIN cross_platform_topic_hotspot th ON th.topic_id = t.id LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON th.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE t.topic_status = 'active'
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{platform}, t.related_platforms)
AND DATE(COALESCE(t.last_seen_time, t.first_seen_time, t.created_at)) = CURDATE()
GROUP BY t.id, t.main_title, t.summary, t.topic_status, t.confidence_score, t.platform_count, t.hotspot_count, t.related_platforms, t.first_seen_time, t.last_seen_time, t.created_at, t.updated_at ORDER BY DATE(COALESCE(t.last_seen_time, t.first_seen_time, t.created_at)) DESC, totalHotValue DESC, t.last_seen_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.main_title AS mainTitle, t.summary, t.topic_status AS topicStatus, t.confidence_score AS confidenceScore, t.platform_count AS platformCount, t.hotspot_count AS hotspotCount, t.related_platforms AS relatedPlatforms, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.last_seen_time, t.first_seen_time, t.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS topicDate, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(h.hot_value, 0)), 0) AS totalHotValue, t.first_seen_time AS firstSeenTime, t.last_seen_time AS lastSeenTime, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cross_platform_topic t LEFT JOIN cross_platform_topic_hotspot th ON th.topic_id = t.id LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON th.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE t.id = #{id} GROUP BY t.id, t.main_title, t.summary, t.topic_status, t.confidence_score, t.platform_count, t.hotspot_count, t.related_platforms, t.first_seen_time, t.last_seen_time, t.created_at, t.updated_at LIMIT 1

SELECT th.topic_id AS topicId, th.hotspot_id AS hotspotId, th.platform, th.title, th.match_score AS matchScore, th.is_primary AS `primary`, h.rank_num AS rankNum, h.hot_value AS hotValue, h.source_url AS sourceUrl, h.crawl_time AS crawlTime FROM cross_platform_topic_hotspot th LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON th.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE th.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY th.is_primary DESC, FIELD(th.platform, 'weibo', 'douyin', 'bilibili'), th.id ASC
